integrity: Finite 16-state exact-integer certificate and independent small-size exhaustive state enumeration are embedded; asymptotics proved from rational pole, not numerical fitting.
scientific_limitations: The cycle length is at least three; synchronous binary inhibitory NOR only. The n=1,2 rational-series coefficients are algebraic extensions. Historical priority may be affected by unindexed or inaccessible literature; no independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: A single inhibitory self-feedback site changes the full recurrent census of ring NOR automata
